# Policy rules

| Rule | Severity | Checks | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FO001` | high | Every record belongs to a registered app | Spend on an unknown app has no owner, so nobody can be asked about it and no budget sees it. |
| `FO002` | high | Every model used has a price in effect on that day | A record with no price is dropped from the totals, which understates spend without any error. |
| `FO003` | high | Every GPU SKU used has a rate in effect on that day | Provisioned GPU hours are often the largest fixed cost; an unrated SKU hides it. |
| `FO004` | high | Busy GPU hours never exceed provisioned hours | It cannot happen, so the export is wrong and every utilisation figure built on it is too. |
| `FO005` | high | No duplicate usage or GPU records for the same day | A record loaded twice doubles that day's cost and looks like a real spike. |
| `FO006` | high | Every app belongs to a registered team | Showback is by team. An app without one cannot be charged to anybody. |
| `FO007` | medium | Every team that spends has a budget, and every budget has a team | A team with no budget can overspend without any signal; a budget for no team guards nothing. |
| `FO008` | high | No team is over budget this month | Spend already exceeds what was agreed; the owner needs to decide, not be told next month. |
| `FO009` | medium | No team is forecast to exceed its budget | At the current run-rate the month ends over budget, while there is still time to act. |
| `FO010` | low | No team has used most of its budget | An early warning, at the threshold the policy sets. |
| `FO011` | medium | Spend without a cost centre stays under the policy limit | Untagged spend cannot be charged back. A little is normal; a lot means tagging has broken. |
| `FO012` | medium | No recent day of spend is anomalous | A sudden jump is usually a loop, a retry storm or a leaked key, and costs more every hour. |
| `FO013` | medium | The usage export is fresh | Every other result is only as current as the export behind it. |
| `FO014` | medium | Cost per outcome is within the app's target | Unit cost is how a budget becomes a business decision: cheaper per outcome, or not worth it. |
| `FO015` | medium | GPU capacity is used | Provisioned hours are paid for whether or not anything runs on them. |
| `FO016` | critical | Shared costs are allocated in full, to the cent | If the allocated parts do not add up to the shared cost, every team's total is wrong. |
| `FO017` | low | Every app that spends reports outcomes | Without outcomes there is no unit cost, only a total that can grow unnoticed. |
